choices.en: everyone saw wukong knock down the tree.
choices.zh: 每个人都看见悟空把树打倒了。

choices.en: the tang monk was upset with wukong.
the great immortal wanted a new ginseng tree.
choices.zh: 大罗天想要一棵新的人参树。

answer_evidence.quote: "But the monkey was inside the whole time," said the other priest.
"He's a spirit," said the first priest.
"He must have used magic."
Inside the abbey the Tang Monk was scolding his companions.
"I am very upset you stole fruit from our hosts."
He suddenly stood much taller.
"I am the Great Immortal! You destroyed my ginseng tree. You're not going any farther until you give me a new one!"

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: why did the priests want to wait for their master?
prompt.zh: 祭司们为什么想等他们的主人？

choices.zh: 他们意识到悟空很强大。

choices.en: their master had a gift for the tang monk.
choices.zh: 他们的师父给了唐僧一份礼物。

choices.en: they wanted to be polite to their guests.

answer_evidence.quote: "Let's wait for our master, the Great Immortal, to return."

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: what did the priests do to the tang monk and his companions?
prompt.zh: 祭司对唐僧和他的同伴做了什么？

choices.zh: 把他们锁在一个房间里

answer_evidence.quote: "You're all welcome to spend the night," said one of the priests. "Follow us."
The priests led the group to a small room in the abbey.
The Tang Monk and his companions went inside.
Wukong noticed that the priests didn't come in.
He was about to say something when one priest slammed the door shut.
A lock clicked.
"Wait!" cried Bajie. "What kind of hosts are you? You locked us in!"

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: how did the tang monk and his companions escape?
prompt.zh: 唐僧和他的同伴是如何逃脱的？

choices.zh: 悟空使用了他的开锁魔法。

choices.en: they climbed out through a window.

answer_evidence.quote: "Master, don't worry," said Wukong.
"I'll get us out of here. When the priests go to sleep, I'll use my lock-picking magic. Then we'll be on our way."
The four travelers escaped that night and headed west.

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: who did the travelers meet on the road?
prompt.zh: 旅行者在路上遇见了谁？

answer_evidence.quote: The next day they saw an old man on the road.
"Excuse me," said the man.
He suddenly stood much taller.
"I am the Great Immortal! You destroyed my ginseng tree. You're not going any farther until you give me a new one!"
